body.objective: Classify every contribution to the hard tagged compact-packet probability at order lambda6 on one fixed BT carrier, transport that complete ledger to the selected dressed scalar experiment, and identify the first genuinely missing dynamical object.
activates: a complete typed q6 object ledger
an exact decision whether source, detector or pure survival are independent q6 summands
the two genuinely missing disconnected packet calculations
body.current_gate: Expand the fixed-BT tagged block through amplitude order lambda4. Use total-Fock parity to eliminate its lambda3 odd block between fixed three-particle projectors, exhaustive tagged support plus coupling order to classify lambda4 as connected six-point tree, spectator identity times active four-point one-loop, and spectator order-two self-energy times active tree, nonforward support to remove only pure survival, and the certified two-sided finite-ideal R_t similarity to show that covariant scalar source/detector dressing is a representation change rather than an additional probability summand.
body.stop_condition: Land a strict CLASSIFIED certificate and independent verifier for the q4/q5/q6 expansion, T3 block zero, complete three-term T4 topology/support split, exact tree-cross import, fixed-frame versus dressed-frame equivalence, pure-survival exclusion, both missing disconnected object statuses, hard-log boundary condition, and all claim boundaries.
body.forbid: no asymptotic hard log called a finite-time compact-packet loop; no formal R_t similarity called general Eq. 19; no source/detector correction double counted after exact pullback; no spectator self-energy discarded merely because the active detector is nonforward; no incomplete ledger called a computed q6 coefficient; no scalar result called gravity or LORENTZIAN-CAUSAL physics
body.resource_hint: On fixed odd three-particle BT projectors write A=lambda2*T2+lambda3*T3+lambda4*T4+... . Pi_F T3 Pi_F=-T3, hence Pout*T3*Pin=0. Exhaustive support leaves connected six-leg and tagged two-plus-four partitions. Coupling order gives T4=C4_tree+I_s tensor L4_active_loop+S2_s tensor A2_active_tree. Therefore q6 is the three corresponding crosses with T2; only the first is certified. Pout Pin=0 in the active nonforward factor removes pure forward survival but not spectator dressing times active scattering. For the selected scalar experiment, P_phi=R_t^dagger P_BT R_t and E_phi=R_t^dagger E_BT R_t with two-sided formal R_t and cyclic finite trace, so all source/detector dressing terms cancel as a similarity and must not be double counted. The missing q6 objects are the active four-point loop and spectator two-point finite-time compact-packet kernels; the known hard logarithm is only an asymptotic consistency condition for the former.
